newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP's Yamasaki retracts extra budget comment - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: LDP's Yamasaki retracts extra budget comment - Jiji.

text.p: The chairman of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party's (LDP) policy research council, Taku Yamasaki, retracted a comment he made earlier on Thursday about the possibility of adopting an extra budget, Jiji news agency reported.

Yamasaki was earlier quoted by Jiji as saying that the option of implementing fiscal stimulus steps such as an extra budget will not be ruled out in a fiscal reform law, which the Japanese government plans to draw up by the end of June.

"We will be cautious in handling fiscal stimulus steps, but we will make sure in the fiscal reform law that emergency fiscal measures necessary for economic management are possible," Jiji quoted Yamasaki, a key figure in the LDP, as saying.
Jiji said Yamasaki later told reporters that the comments "were not accurate," and that he wished to withdraw them.
He said that including a provision into the planned fiscal reform bill was not technically possible, Jiji said.
